title: BiyaHey! curated jeepney / UV Express route inventory
description: Shape of data/routes/jeepney-inventory.yaml (spec 8.1, Task 7). Every field the source does not publish is null, never guessed; provenance and licence are stated in the file header. Validated by `npm run validate:data` and by pipeline.inventory.load_inventory.

routes.description: One entry per LTFRB route number, in the order the source lists them.

code.description: The LTFRB route number exactly as published (T101, 101, C20, M01, N02, ...). Uppercase alphanumerics only, so the derived route id is stable.

name.description: The route name exactly as published: '<first endpoint> - <second endpoint> via <midpoints/roads>' per LTFRB naming.

mode.description: Vehicle family. Drives the route-id prefix: jeep- for jeepney, uv- for uv-express.

endpoints.description: The two terminals the route name states, in name order. Splitting the published name is transcription, not inference.

via_roads.description: Roads the route runs along, taken from the name's 'via ...' fragment and from the published route description, in source order. May be empty when the source names no road.

stop_landmarks.description: Terminals and landmarks the source names for this route, in travel order. Non-empty by design: v1 wayfinding is landmark-first, so a route with no named landmark is not publishable.

headway_peak_min.description: Peak headway in whole minutes, or null when no source publishes one. The OSM Wiki list publishes no headways, so the seed is null throughout and the build falls back to the pinned GTFS defaults.

headway_offpeak_min.description: Off-peak headway in whole minutes, or null. See headway_peak_min.

typical_length_km.description: Published route length in kilometres, or null when the source states none. Never estimated.

operator.description: The franchised operator named by the source, verbatim (several cooperatives may be listed), or null when the source leaves it blank. Null means 'not published', not 'no operator'.

source_url.description: The exact source section this entry was transcribed from. Must be https and citable.

needs_verification.description: True until the entry is independently corroborated against a second source (e.g. an LTFRB memorandum circular). The seed ships entirely true.
